# Read each tool call and its result
for tnum in range(1, 10):
    t_start = full_text.find(f"[tool {tnum}]")
    r_start = full_text.find(f"[result {tnum}]")
    if t_start >= 0 and r_start >= 0 and t_start > 0:
        print(f"\n{'='*80}")
        print(f"[tool {tnum}]")
        print(full_text[t_start:r_start])
        print()
        # Find end of result - next tool or section
        next_tool = full_text.find(f"[tool {tnum+1}]")
        if next_tool < 0:
            next_tool = full_text.find("[grade]")
        if next_tool < 0:
            next_tool = len(full_text)
        print(f"[result {tnum}]")
        print(full_text[r_start:next_tool])
    elif t_start >= 0:
        print(f"\n{'='*80}")
        print(f"[tool {tnum}]")
        next_section = full_text.find("[grade]")
        print(full_text[t_start:next_section])
    else:
        print(f"[tool {tnum}] not found")
